# 🎼 UI + API test automation (minimal)

A compact UI + API pack with four helpers: explore (OpenAPI and/or Playwright MCP), plan, set up a test framework if none exists, and implement tests, each returning the same handoff packet. Pick it for a small first batch of tests or a project without a test framework; for a full suite with review and verification stages, use ui-api-automation.

Install: `ui-api-automation-minimal@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Start the pack

| Tool | How |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot | Pick **QA Orchestrator (Minimal)** in the agent dropdown and describe the job. It hands off to the other agents. |
| Claude Code | Run `/ui-api-automation-minimal` followed by the job. The command coordinates; the agents below do the work. |
| OpenAI Codex | Copy [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into `.codex/agents/`, then run `$ui-api-automation-minimal` followed by the job. |

Claude Code and Codex agents cannot start other agents, so there the orchestrator is a command that runs in your conversation.

## Agents

| Agent | Name in Claude Code and Codex | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **QA Orchestrator (Minimal)** (orchestrator) | `/ui-api-automation-minimal` command | Coordinates a short explore, plan, set-up and implement loop for UI and/or API tests, and writes a timestamped automation summary to .ai-outputs/. Use for a small first batch of tests or a project without a test framework; the ui-api-automation pack adds review and verification stages. |
| Test Coder Agent (Minimal) | `uiapi-min-coder` / `uiapi_min_coder` | Implements the UI or API test tasks it is assigned from a test plan, following the repository's conventions, and runs them before handing back. Use as the implementation step of the minimal UI + API pack. |
| Explorer Agent (Minimal) | `uiapi-min-explorer` / `uiapi_min_explorer` | Explores an OpenAPI spec or the running UI (through Playwright MCP) and writes a short summary of structure, P0 journeys and flakiness risks to .ai-outputs/. Use as the exploration step of the minimal UI + API pack. |
| Test Framework Starter Agent (Minimal) | `uiapi-min-framework-starter` / `uiapi_min_framework_starter` | Sets up a minimal Playwright test project (config, folders, one smoke run) when the repository has no usable test framework, and reports the existing setup otherwise. Use in the minimal UI + API pack before implementation. |
| Test Planner (Minimal) | `uiapi-min-planner` / `uiapi_min_planner` | Turns the exploration summaries into a short, prioritized test plan (P0 first) written to .ai-outputs/. Use as the planning step of the minimal UI + API pack. |

## MCP servers

- `playwright`: `npx @playwright/mcp@latest`

Claude Code and Codex start these from the plugin. In GitHub Copilot, the agents that need them configure them themselves.

How the pack works, step by step: [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md).
